description: Writing a world owner's list (protocol/10-identity.md, "A world's own lists"; BitGate's shape, as `governance-lists.json` reads it): what a writer makes from one change on the list it has (`before`, or null for none) at the writer's clock `now`. The rules: `add` puts the person on and `remove` takes them off; every other person stays; the `p` tags are each person once, in order of their keys; the tags come in the order given (`d`, `v`, `scope`, `subject`, then the `p`s); `content` is empty; `created_at` is `now`, or one second after `before.createdAt` where that is not earlier, so the new list replaces the old; more than 500 people is refused, and nothing is written. `signed` is `event` signed with key 1, the world's publisher; `readBack` is what `readOwnerList` gives for it.

testKeys.note: TEST-ONLY keys derived from public strings: sha256(utf8(label)). Anyone can sign as them. Signatures use 32 zero bytes of BIP-340 aux randomness so they are reproducible.
